channel.title: Sound baths in Fort Collins · Sound Bath Calendar
channel.description: A weekly-updated calendar of sound baths in Fort Collins, Colorado: dates, times, venues, prices, and ticket links for every listed session. Part of the Front Range sound bath calendar.

item.title: Nourish: Women's Circle & Sound Bath
item.description: A 90-minute women's circle at The Living Room in downtown Fort Collins, Wednesday evening: guided meditation and facilitated sharing closing with a sound bath and hands-on massage. Where: The Living Room, Fort Collins. Price: See link. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/nourish-womens-circle-sound-bath-2026-08-26-the-living-room/

item.title: Thursday Mind Body Reset — Gong Journey
item.description: The weekly Thursday gong journey at Rocky Mountain Restore & Stretch in Fort Collins, 6:15pm, played on large gongs and followed by tea; no experience required. Where: Rocky Mountain Restore & Stretch, Fort Collins. Price: See link. Details: https://soundbathcalendar.com/event/thursday-mind-body-reset-gong-journey-2026-08-27-rocky-mountain-restore-stretch/
